country: Al Jumhuriyah al Arabiyah as Suriyah

fields.climate: mostly desert; hot, dry, sunny summers (June to August) and mild, rainy winters (December to February) along coast; cold weather with snow or sleet periodically in Damascus
fields.terrain: primarily semiarid and desert plateau; narrow coastal plain; mountains in west
fields.hazards: dust storms, sandstorms; volcanism: Syria's two historically active volcanoes, Es Safa and an unnamed volcano near the Turkish border, have not erupted in centuries
fields.resources: petroleum, phosphates, chrome and manganese ores, asphalt, iron ore, rock salt, marble, gypsum, hydropower
fields.farm: wheat, barley, milk, sheep milk, tomatoes, olives, potatoes, maize, oranges, grapes
fields.exports: olive oil, phosphates, spice seeds, cotton, tomatoes
fields.industries: petroleum, textiles, food processing, beverages, tobacco, phosphate rock mining, cement, oil seeds crushing, automobile assembly
fields.languages: Arabic (official), Kurdish, Armenian, Aramaic, Circassian, French, English
fields.religions: Muslim 87% (official; includes Sunni 74% and Alawi, Ismaili, and Shia 13%), Christian 10% (includes Orthodox, Uniate, and Nestorian), Druze 3%

independence.from: League of Nations mandate under French administration

fields.legal: mixed system of civil and Islamic (sharia) law (for family courts)
fields.military: under Bashar al-ASAD, Syrian men aged 18-38 were required to serve 18-21 months in the military…
